newsitem.title: USA: Apple unveils server and other products.
newsitem.headline: Apple unveils server and other products.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc on Tuesday unveiled what it called the world's fastest Mac OS server, as part of a flurry of annoucements setting out its product direction at the annual MacWorld Expo trade show.
Apple also announced the availability of MacApp Release 13, a updated version of software that helps developers quickly write applications to run on its Mac OS system.
The company said it was using MacWorld in Boston to kick off a national roadshow in which it planned to show off its new Power Macintosh and PowerBook systems in more than 30 cities.
